## GDescriptionResult type

Result of `TemplateManager.getGDescription` for a `<g-description>` block.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type GDescriptionResult = {
    kind: `description`;
    text: string;
};
```

## Remarks

`text` is the rendered command description; a missing block yields `{kind: "description", text: ""}`<!-- -->.
